// The program that wrote table_oracle.json. It is kept here, as text the Go
// tool does not build, because the table it reads is gone from this tree.
//
// Source: commit 741ce8b0f5d46d981e8dd426b1a378ac64576e4b ("docs(plans):
// record how step 4 fixes the review and migrates old imports", the head of
// feat/dynamic-units-4), the last commit holding the engine's unit table
// (internal/vocabulary/unitstable.go). It runs as a test of package
// vocabulary_test there, beside unitseed_test.go, whose helpers it uses
// (shippedGraph, seedID, tableMap, seedAnnotations).
//
// Procedure, from the repository's root:
//
//	mkdir /tmp/capture && git archive 741ce8b0f | tar -x -C /tmp/capture
//	cp internal/engine/unitseed/testdata/table_oracle_capture.go.txt \
//	  /tmp/capture/internal/vocabulary/table_oracle_capture_test.go
//	(cd /tmp/capture && TABLE_ORACLE_COMMIT=741ce8b0f5d46d981e8dd426b1a378ac64576e4b \
//	  TABLE_ORACLE_OUT=/tmp/table_oracle.json \
//	  go test -count=1 -run '^TestCaptureTableOracle$' ./internal/vocabulary/)
//
// /tmp/table_oracle.json is then byte for byte this directory's file.
//
// It wrote 216 units in 67 components and 316 spellings on 2026-10-21.
// Never rerun it against a later commit: the file is the table's answer.

package vocabulary_test

// The capture of internal/engine/unitseed/testdata/table_oracle.json, run once
// at the last commit that held the engine's unit table. Every map and every
// component boundary below is read from the table (Measures, ConvertIn
// through tableMap, UnitCodes, UnitAliases); the graph built from the seed is
// only asserted against, never copied.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/geoah/substrate/internal/vocabulary"
)

type oracleUnit struct {
	Root   string `json:"root"`
	Factor string `json:"factor,omitempty"`
	Offset string `json:"offset,omitempty"`
	Delta  string `json:"delta"`
}

type oracleEdge struct {
	to             string
	factor, offset *big.Rat
	difference     bool
}

func TestCaptureTableOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("TABLE_ORACLE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("TABLE_ORACLE_OUT names no file")
	}
	g := shippedGraph(t)
	id := func(code string) string { return seedID(t, code) }

	// Every pair the table converts inside a measure is an edge, read from
	// the table alone.
	edges := map[string][]oracleEdge{}
	for _, u := range g.Units() {
		edges[u.ID] = nil
	}
	for _, m := range vocabulary.Measures() {
		difference := m.Scale == vocabulary.ScaleDifference
		for _, a := range m.Units {
			for _, b := range m.Units {
				if a == b {
					continue
				}
				f, o, ok := tableMap(m.Name, a, b)
				if !ok {
					continue
				}
				edges[id(a)] = append(edges[id(a)], oracleEdge{to: id(b), factor: f, offset: o, difference: difference})
			}
		}
	}
	// Components: the classes the table's edges join. The root is the
	// smallest id in byte order, the graph's documented rule.
	comp := map[string]string{}
	for start := range edges {
		if _, done := comp[start]; done {
			continue
		}
		members := []string{start}
		seen := map[string]bool{start: true}
		for i := 0; i < len(members); i++ {
			for _, e := range edges[members[i]] {
				if !seen[e.to] {
					seen[e.to] = true
					members = append(members, e.to)
				}
			}
		}
		sort.Strings(members)
		for _, m := range members {
			comp[m] = members[0]
		}
	}
	// Maps to the root: absolute ones through the non-difference measures'
	// edges, a difference's through every edge's factor alone.
	walk := func(root string, useDifference bool) map[string][2]*big.Rat {
		maps := map[string][2]*big.Rat{root: {big.NewRat(1, 1), new(big.Rat)}}
		queue := []string{root}
		for len(queue) > 0 {
			y := queue[0]
			queue = queue[1:]
			for x, es := range edges {
				for _, e := range es {
					if e.to != y || (e.difference && !useDifference) {
						continue
					}
					if _, done := maps[x]; done {
						continue
					}
					// y = x*f + o and root = y*F + O, so root = x*(f*F) + (o*F + O).
					F, O := maps[y][0], maps[y][1]
					f := new(big.Rat).Mul(e.factor, F)
					o := new(big.Rat).Add(new(big.Rat).Mul(e.offset, F), O)
					if useDifference {
						o = new(big.Rat)
					}
					maps[x] = [2]*big.Rat{f, o}
					queue = append(queue, x)
				}
			}
		}
		return maps
	}
	units := map[string]oracleUnit{}
	roots := map[string]bool{}
	for _, r := range comp {
		roots[r] = true
	}
	for root := range roots {
		abs, diff := walk(root, false), walk(root, true)
		for u, r := range comp {
			if r != root {
				continue
			}
			d, ok := diff[u]
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s: no map to its root %s", u, root)
			}
			ou := oracleUnit{Root: root, Delta: d[0].RatString()}
			if a, ok := abs[u]; ok {
				ou.Factor, ou.Offset = a[0].RatString(), a[1].RatString()
			}
			units[u] = ou
		}
	}

	// The capture is held to the step-4 graph, which the parity tests held
	// to the table: if the two disagree the capture is wrong.
	for _, u := range g.Units() {
		members := g.Component(u.ID)
		var want []string
		for v, r := range comp {
			if r == comp[u.ID] {
				want = append(want, v)
			}
		}
		sort.Strings(want)
		sort.Strings(members)
		if !slices.Equal(members, want) {
			t.Errorf("%s: the graph's component %v, the table's %v", u.ID, members, want)
		}
		if r, _ := g.Root(u.ID); r != comp[u.ID] {
			t.Errorf("%s: the graph's root %s, the table's %s", u.ID, r, comp[u.ID])
		}
	}

	// Spellings: every code the table listed, every input alias and the
	// annotated counts, from the table; and every spelling the seed's
	// records declare (id, code, aliases).
	spellings := map[string]string{}
	add := func(s, u string) {
		if prev, ok := spellings[s]; ok && prev != u {
			t.Fatalf("%q names %s and %s", s, prev, u)
		}
		spellings[s] = u
	}
	for _, code := range append(vocabulary.UnitCodes(), seedAnnotations...) {
		add(code, id(code))
	}
	for alias, code := range vocabulary.UnitAliases() {
		add(alias, id(code))
	}
	for _, u := range g.Units() {
		add(u.ID, u.ID)
		if u.Code != "" {
			add(u.Code, u.ID)
		}
		for _, a := range u.Aliases {
			add(a, u.ID)
		}
	}
	for s, u := range spellings {
		if got, ok := g.Resolve(s); !ok || got != u {
			t.Errorf("%q: the graph resolves %q, %v; the table %s", s, got, ok, u)
		}
	}
	if t.Failed() {
		return
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"source": map[string]string{
			"commit":    os.Getenv("TABLE_ORACLE_COMMIT"),
			"procedure": "internal/engine/unitseed/testdata/table_oracle_capture.go.txt, run at the commit",
		},
		"units": units, "spellings": spellings,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("%d units, %d components, %d spellings", len(units), len(roots), len(spellings))
}
